summary: Subscribes to messages arriving on a specific WebSocket channel/topic from remote clients or the HttpFileServer broker.

ports.name: Server Instance
ports.text: The Server Instance object from Ops.Local.Standalone.HttpFileServer.

ports.name: Channel
ports.text: The channel/topic name to filter messages on. Use '*' to listen to all channels.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Enable or disable message reception for this subscription.

ports.name: Auto Parse JSON
ports.text: Automatically parses string payloads into JavaScript objects.

ports.name: On Message
ports.text: Fires whenever a message matching the channel filter arrives.

ports.name: Channel
ports.text: The actual channel name of the received message.

ports.name: Data
ports.text: The parsed data payload (object, array, string, number).

ports.name: Raw Message
ports.text: The unparsed string representation of the payload.

ports.name: Sender Client ID
ports.text: Unique ID of the client that sent this message ('patch' if emitted internally).

ports.name: Total Received
ports.text: Cumulative counter of messages received on this subscription.

ports.name: Timestamp
ports.text: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the message was dispatched.
